  function flightMonitor() {
    const storageKey = "flight-search:past-searches";

    // Get the item from localStorage
    const storedValue = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);

    if (storedValue) {
      // Parse JSON string into an object
      const parsed = JSON.parse(storedValue);

      // Access the 0th past search
      const firstSearch = parsed.data.pastSearches[0];

      // Extract required values
      const departureCode = firstSearch.ondValueFrom.airportCode;
      const destinationCode = firstSearch.ondValueTo.airportCode;

      const departureCity = firstSearch.ondValueFrom.city;
      const destinationCity = firstSearch.ondValueTo.city;

      const passengersCount =
        firstSearch.adultsCount + firstSearch.infantsCount;

      // const cabinClass = firstSearch.cabinClassValue.label;

      const departureDate = firstSearch.dateRangeValueFrom;
      const arrivalDate = firstSearch.dateRangeValueTo;
      const isOneWay = firstSearch.isOneWay;

      // Format the departure and arrival dates
      const formatDate = function (dateString) {
        const date = new Date(dateString);
        const options = {
          day: "2-digit",
          month: "short",
          year: "numeric",
        };
        return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", options); // Returns in "11 Jun 2025" format
      };

      const formattedDepartureDate = formatDate(departureDate);
      const formattedArrivalDate = formatDate(arrivalDate);

      // Combine passengers count and cabin class into one string
      var passengerInfo = passengersCount + " Passenger";
      if (passengersCount !== 1) {
        passengerInfo += "s";
      }
      // passengerInfo += ', ' + cabinClass;

      console.log(
        departureCode,
        destinationCode,
        departureCity,
        destinationCity,
        passengerInfo,
        formattedDepartureDate,
        formattedArrivalDate,
        isOneWay,
      );

      alloy("sendEvent", {
        edgeConfigOverrides: {
          datastreamId: "622290d4-f386-49f7-b475-78e2f8074e5f",
        },
        renderDecisions: false,
        decisionScopes: ["__view__"],
        data: {
          __adobe: {
            target: {
              "profile.lsfDeparture": departureCode,
              "profile.lsfDestination": destinationCode,
              "profile.lsfDepartureCity": departureCity,
              "profile.lsfDestinationCity": destinationCity,
              "profile.lsfPassengerAndCabin": passengerInfo,
              "profile.lsfDepartureDate": formattedDepartureDate,
              "profile.lsfArrivalDate": formattedArrivalDate,
              "profile.lsfIsOneWay": isOneWay,
            },
          },
        },
      });
    } else {
      console.log("No data found in localStorage for key:", storageKey);
    }
  }

    if (!stickyElement || !targetElement) return;

    const isEdge = navigator.userAgent.includes('Edg/');

    function updateMargin() {
        if (stickyElement.classList.contains('sticked')) {
            if (isChrome) {
                targetElement.style.marginTop = '25px';
            } else if (isEdge) {
                targetElement.style.marginTop = '50px';
            }
        } else {
            targetElement.style.marginTop = '';
        }
    }

    // Initial check
    updateMargin();

    // Watch for class changes
    const observer = new MutationObserver(updateMargin);

    observer.observe(stickyElement, {
        attributes: true,
        attributeFilter: ['class']
    });
})();

  function flightMonitor() {
    const storageKey = "flight-search:past-searches";

    // Get the item from localStorage
    const storedValue = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);

      // Parse JSON string into an object
      const parsed = JSON.parse(storedValue);

      // Access the 0th past search
      const firstSearch = parsed.data.pastSearches[0];

      // Extract required values
      const departureCode = firstSearch.ondValueFrom.airportCode;
      const destinationCode = firstSearch.ondValueTo.airportCode;

      const departureCity = firstSearch.ondValueFrom.city;
      const destinationCity = firstSearch.ondValueTo.city;

      const passengersCount =
        firstSearch.adultsCount + firstSearch.infantsCount;

      // const cabinClass = firstSearch.cabinClassValue.label;

      const departureDate = firstSearch.dateRangeValueFrom;
      const arrivalDate = firstSearch.dateRangeValueTo;
      const isOneWay = firstSearch.isOneWay;

      // Format the departure and arrival dates
      const formatDate = function (dateString) {
        const date = new Date(dateString);
        const options = {
          day: "2-digit",
          month: "short",
          year: "numeric",
        };
        return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", options); // Returns in "11 Jun 2025" format
      };

      const formattedDepartureDate = formatDate(departureDate);
      const formattedArrivalDate = formatDate(arrivalDate);

      // Combine passengers count and cabin class into one string
      var passengerInfo = passengersCount + " Passenger";
      if (passengersCount !== 1) {
        passengerInfo += "s";
      }
      // passengerInfo += ', ' + cabinClass;

      console.log(
        departureCode,
        destinationCode,
        departureCity,
        destinationCity,
        passengerInfo,
        formattedDepartureDate,
        formattedArrivalDate,
        isOneWay,

              "profile.lsfPassengerAndCabin": passengerInfo,
              "profile.lsfDepartureDate": formattedDepartureDate,
              "profile.lsfArrivalDate": formattedArrivalDate,
              "profile.lsfIsOneWay": isOneWay,
            },
          },
        },
      });
    } else {
      console.log("No data found in localStorage for key:", storageKey);
    }

    });
